# Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue. Describe the motivation, context, and any dependencies.

Closes # (issue)

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Refactor (code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Test addition or improvement
- [ ] Dependency update

## How Has This Been Tested?

Please describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes.

- [ ] Unit tests (`fvm flutter test`)
- [ ] Widget tests
- [ ] Integration tests
- [ ] Manual testing on device/emulator

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project's coding style and conventions
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented complex code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or analysis issues
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally (`fvm flutter test`)
- [ ] Static analysis passes (`fvm flutter analyze`)
- [ ] My commits follow the [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) specification

## Security Considerations

- [ ] No secrets, keys, or credentials are exposed
- [ ] All external communication uses TLS/SSL
- [ ] Sensitive data is stored in secure storage (flutter_secure_storage)
- [ ] Input validation is applied at trust boundaries
